volume_alerts.selecting_100M: vol-toggle text = 'Vol ≥ $100M4', vol-count badge visible, footer-vol visible, 3 vol-flag- badges rendered on rows

exportCSV filename uses local time via toISOString slice — acceptable but consider ISO with timezone for clarity
